question: Latest leg-to-wheel policy: landing sway and actuator delay sensitivity

method.landing_detection: First wheel world normal force z sum above contact-sensor threshold 10 N, after reference frame 60 (1.2 s).
method.post_window: First detected landing through terminal pre-reset sample; only completed frame-zero episodes aggregated.
method.tail_window: Reference frames 112..141 inclusive, last 0.6 s; incomplete episodes excluded.
method.orientation: Root and reference quaternion wxyz converted to roll/pitch/yaw, degrees. Error wrapped to [-180,180].
method.force_semantics: Net normal contact force averaged over each completed 5 ms step; excludes friction. Peaks are per wheel and summed world z.
method.torque_semantics: Computed and applied actuator drive torque; excludes passive impact loads.
method.success_semantics: Reached motion_finished without other termination, not a stability acceptance gate.
